stem: Which sentence best shows that Maniac approaches the challenge of the knot with thoughtfulness?

options.label: F
options.text: Mr. Cobble himself came out to offer Maniac some pizza, which Maniac of course politely turned down.

options.label: G
options.text: Never a big pull or yank, just his fingertips touching and grazing and peck-pecking away, like some little bird.

options.label: H
options.text: The rest of the spectators watched Maniac poke and tug and pick at the knot.

options.label: J
options.text: He scraped a patch of crust off with his fingernail.
